He cornered me to the back of the strip and started a broken time attack. I dropped to the back leg to parry,  making it easy for him to touch. Against a broken time attack it would be better to maybe stop hit (since he slowed down),  parry with a step forward (or still since the distance is close),   or even close (although he would expect that),  or hide behind my arm

He lunged into my attack so I tried to finish in the back,  which was mostly being closed by his lunge. I could have finished on the chest (a feint in the back and then finishing in the chest would work even better) and I could have tried a counter time. But also maybe better flicking mechanics could have let me hit too.
